Moment climate activists throw red paint over 133-year-old Christopher Columbus painting before being dragged out of museum in Madrid

This is the moment two climate activists threw red paint over a 133-year-old painting of Christopher Columbus in a Madrid museum.  The two female activists, from the Futuro Vegetal movement, were allegedly seen throwing biodegradable red paint over José Garnelo's 'First Tribute to Christopher Columbus' at Madrid's Naval Museum on Sunday.  A small gathered crowd shouted at them as they chucked the paint over the artwork, which depicts Columbus landing in the New World in 1492.
